form_factor_en: Discrete eUICC chip soldered to the motherboard (~6x5 mm), no removable slot
form_factor_zh: 焊接於主機板的獨立 eUICC 晶片（約 6x5 mm），無可插拔卡槽
summary_en: An embedded chip that replaces the removable plastic SIM. Profiles are downloaded and switched remotely (Remote SIM Provisioning), but it still occupies a dedicated area on the board.
summary_zh: 以嵌入式晶片取代可插拔的塑膠 SIM。設定檔可遠端下載與切換（遠端 SIM 配置 RSP），但仍佔用板上專屬空間。
adoption_en: Widely adopted today across consumer and IoT devices
adoption_zh: 目前已於消費性與 IoT 裝置廣泛採用
pbx_relevance_en: Cellular-bearer failover and primary WAN for SIM-based VoIP gateways, mobile UCaaS clients, and fixed-wireless PBX trunks.
pbx_relevance_zh: 作為 SIM 型 VoIP 閘道、行動 UCaaS 客戶端與固定無線 PBX 中繼的行動承載備援與主要 WAN。

form_factor_en: SIM function integrated directly into the device SoC (<1x1 mm), no separate chip
form_factor_zh: SIM 功能直接整合進裝置 SoC（<1x1 mm），無獨立晶片
summary_en: Integrates SIM functionality into the main processor's secure enclave. Uses up to 70% less power and frees board space, leveraging the processor's Trusted Execution Environment (TEE).
summary_zh: 將 SIM 功能整合進主處理器的安全區。功耗最高可降 70% 並釋放板上空間，並運用處理器的可信執行環境（TEE）。
security_en: TEE inside the SoC — higher tamper resistance
security_zh: SoC 內 TEE — 更高防篡改能力
adoption_en: Ramping: ~0.8M devices in 2024, projected >10M in 2026, 211.8M active by 2028
adoption_zh: 快速成長：2024 約 80 萬台，2026 預估 >1000 萬台，2028 達 2.118 億台活躍裝置
pbx_relevance_en: Enables ultra-compact always-connected endpoints (badges, sensors, panic buttons) that register to cellular voice/data without a board-level SIM, decades-long battery telemetry for remote PBX sites.
pbx_relevance_zh: 讓超精巧的常連端點（識別證、感測器、緊急按鈕）無需板上 SIM 即可註冊行動語音/資料，並為遠端 PBX 站點提供可達數十年的電池遙測。

name_zh: SoftSIM / vSIM（軟體 / 虛擬 SIM）
form_factor_en: No dedicated hardware — SIM runs as software in the application processor / modem general memory
form_factor_zh: 無專屬硬體 — SIM 以軟體形式運行於應用處理器/數據機通用記憶體
summary_en: The most de-hardwared direction: removes all SIM hardware dependency, running credentials purely as a software library with cloud-based dynamic download and management. Eliminates SIM-related BOM cost entirely.
summary_zh: 最徹底的「去硬體化」方向：移除所有 SIM 硬體依賴，憑證純以軟體函式庫形式運行，並透過雲端動態下載與管理。完全消除 SIM 相關物料（BOM）成本。
security_en: No dedicated SE — relies on TEE + cloud attestation (historically debated)
security_zh: 無專屬安全元件 — 依賴 TEE + 雲端驗證（安全性歷來受討論）
adoption_en: Early commercial pilots; security model maturing via TEE + cloud attestation
adoption_zh: 早期商用試點；安全模型透過 TEE + 雲端驗證逐步成熟
pbx_relevance_en: Zero-BOM cellular identity for disposable / high-volume voice-enabled IoT and field gateways, cloud-managed fleet provisioning aligns with UCaaS / RAG-driven catalog automation.
pbx_relevance_zh: 為拋棄式/大量語音化 IoT 與現場閘道提供零 BOM 行動身分；雲端管理的機隊配置與 UCaaS / RAG 驅動目錄自動化相契合。

name_zh: GSMA SGP.32（IoT eSIM / 遠端配置）
form_factor_en: Specification — unifies M2M and consumer eSIM remote provisioning for IoT
form_factor_zh: 規範 — 為 IoT 統一 M2M 與消費型 eSIM 的遠端配置
summary_en: GSMA's IoT eSIM specification. Lets iSIM and eSIM share the same Remote SIM Provisioning (RSP) architecture via an eSIM IoT Manager (eIM), drastically cutting global deployment complexity and enabling operator switching at IoT scale.
summary_zh: GSMA 的 IoT eSIM 規範。讓 iSIM 與 eSIM 透過 eSIM IoT 管理器（eIM）共用同一遠端 SIM 配置（RSP）架構，大幅降低全球部署複雜度，並讓 IoT 規模可靈活切換營運商。
security_en: Defines secure eIM-based profile management without SMS dependency
security_zh: 定義以 eIM 為基礎、不依賴 SMS 的安全設定檔管理
adoption_en: 2025-2026 industry focus shifting from manufacturing to SGP.32 compliance & interoperability certification
adoption_zh: 2025-2026 產業重點由製造轉向 SGP.32 合規與互操作性認證
pbx_relevance_en: Software-defined, SMS-free provisioning is the enabler for fleet-managed cellular voice endpoints and is the key that unlocks iSIM/SoftSIM at scale.
pbx_relevance_zh: 軟體定義、免 SMS 的配置，是機隊化行動語音端點的關鍵推力，也是釋放 iSIM/SoftSIM 規模化潛力的鑰匙。

form_factor_en: Specification pair — iSIM architecture (41) and iSIM remote provisioning (42)
form_factor_zh: 規範組 — iSIM 架構（41）與 iSIM 遠端配置（42）
summary_en: The standards purpose-built for iSIM. SGP.41 defines the iSIM architecture; SGP.42 defines remote provisioning. Together they replace SMS-based legacy flows with efficient, secure profile activation through the eIM.
summary_zh: 專為 iSIM 打造的標準。SGP.41 定義 iSIM 架構；SGP.42 定義遠端配置。兩者以透過 eIM 進行的高效安全設定檔啟用，取代舊式 SMS 流程。
security_zh: eIM 驅動的啟用/切換，不依賴 SMS
use_cases_zh: 大規模 IoT 遠端配置
adoption_en: Expected to drive the 2026+ iSIM device surge toward 211.8M active devices by 2028
adoption_zh: 預期推動 2026 年起 iSIM 裝置激增，至 2028 達 2.118 億台活躍裝置
pbx_relevance_en: The provisioning backbone that makes board-less cellular voice/data endpoints operationally viable at carrier scale.
pbx_relevance_zh: 讓無板上 SIM 的行動語音/資料端點在電信規模下可營運的配置骨幹。

name_zh: NTN（非地面網路 / 直連衛星）
form_factor_en: Network architecture — native satellite support folded into new SIM profiles
form_factor_zh: 網路架構 — 將原生衛星支援納入新一代 SIM 設定檔
summary_en: With Direct-to-Cell satellite connectivity rising, new SIM specs add native satellite support. iSIM/SoftSIM can seamlessly hand over between terrestrial and non-terrestrial networks without reconfiguration.
summary_zh: 隨著直連衛星（Direct-to-Cell）興起，新 SIM 規範加入原生衛星支援。iSIM/SoftSIM 可在地面與非地面網路間無縫切換，無需重新配置。
security_en: Inherits SIM credential security across bearers
security_zh: 跨承載沿用 SIM 憑證安全
adoption_en: Active rollout via satellite operators and carrier Direct-to-Cell partnerships
adoption_zh: 透過衛星營運商與電信商直連衛星合作積極部署中
pbx_relevance_en: Guarantees voice/SMS reachability for distributed and off-grid PBX sites where terrestrial PSTN/IP backhaul is unavailable, a non-PSTN command path for resilient dispatch.
pbx_relevance_zh: 為地面 PSTN/IP 回傳不可得的分散與離網 PBX 站點，保障語音/簡訊可達性；屬於韌性調度的非 PSTN 控制路徑。

form_factor_en: Network generation — SIM takes on dynamic slicing & richer authentication roles
form_factor_zh: 網路世代 — SIM 承擔動態切片與更豐富的認證角色
summary_en: Under 5G-Advanced the SIM handles more complex identity duties, including dynamic permissions for Network Slicing, positioning the SIM as a key to multi-dimensional network access rather than just authentication.
summary_zh: 在 5G-Advanced 下，SIM 承擔更複雜的身分職責，包含網路切片（Network Slicing）的動態權限，使 SIM 成為多維網路存取的鑰匙，而非僅是身分認證。
use_cases_zh: QoS 關鍵語音的網路切片
adoption_zh: 商用部署自 2025-2026 起擴大
pbx_relevance_en: Dedicated network slices can guarantee call-quality SLAs for enterprise UCaaS and contact-center voice over private/public 5G, SIM-bound slice permissions enforce tenant isolation.
pbx_relevance_zh: 專屬網路切片可為企業 UCaaS 與客服語音在私有/公有 5G 上保障通話品質 SLA；綁定 SIM 的切片權限可落實租戶隔離。

form_factor_en: Future network generation — iSIM seen as foundational connectivity infrastructure
form_factor_zh: 未來網路世代 — iSIM 被視為基礎連接基礎設施
summary_en: iSIM is positioned as a key building block toward the 6G era, where ubiquitous, AI-native, sensing-integrated networks demand the smallest, lowest-power, most secure embedded identity.
summary_zh: iSIM 被定位為通往 6G 時代的關鍵基石；在無所不在、AI 原生、整合感測的網路中，需要最小、最低功耗、最安全的嵌入式身分。
adoption_zh: 標準化前研究；商用時程約 2030
pbx_relevance_en: Long-horizon planning signal: voice becomes one service among AI-native, sensing-rich connectivity, embedded identity (iSIM) underpins trusted endpoints.
pbx_relevance_zh: 長期規劃訊號：語音將成為 AI 原生、富感測連接中的服務之一；嵌入式身分（iSIM）支撐可信端點。
